# Target the main dashboard surface
surface("dashboard-metrics-overview")

# Define the KPI Metrics Data directly for the metric_row component
kpi_metrics = [
    {value: "$124,500", label: "Monthly Revenue", sub: "vs last month", trend: "up", accent: "#10B981"},
    {value: "1,420", label: "Active Subscriptions", sub: "+12% increase", trend: "up", accent: "#3B82F6"},
    {value: "98.2%", label: "SLA Compliance", sub: "Target 99%", trend: "down", accent: "#EF4444"},
    {value: "4.8m", label: "Average Response Time", sub: "Steady", trend: "up", accent: "#10B981"}
]

# Create the KPI metric row using 4 columns
kpis = metric_row(4, "#3B82F6", kpi_metrics)

# Create a trend/comparison chart utilizing stacked_area to display growth across categories

    {"label": "Professional", "data": [30, 35, 40, 45, 48, 52], "color": "#10B981"},
    {"label": "Standard", "data": [15, 18, 22, 24, 23, 25], "color": "#F59E0B"}
]
comparison_chart = stacked_area("Revenue Growth Breakdown (USD k)", chart_labels, chart_series, "area")

# Arrange the workspace layout with heading, metrics row, and comparison chart
root = columns(
    1,
    "2rem",
    "top",
    [
        {blocks: [heading("Operations & Revenue Overview")]},
        {blocks: [kpis]},
        {blocks: [comparison_chart]}
    ]
)
